serverInfo.title: NSW Planning Data (x402)
serverInfo.description: NSW planning data for AI agents: development applications and complying development certificates (search by council/suburb/postcode, nearby within 2 km, full detail), development activity near an address, and one-call property planning reports (zoning, height, FSR, lot size, heritage). Free summary tools; paid tools charge per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Data from the NSW Planning Portal (CC BY 4.0), synced several times a day.
